title: Role of Shape Deformation of DNA-Binding Sites in Regulating the Efficiency and Specificity in Their Recognition by DNA-Binding Proteins.
authors: Sangeeta; Mishra, Sujeet Kumar; Bhattacherjee, Arnab
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算机模拟揭示DNA结合位点形状变形如何通过熵漏斗调控蛋白质-DNA识别效率与特异性，聚焦TF-DNA类结合位点的形状读出机制，与课题高度匹配。
abstract: Accurate transcription of genetic information is crucial, involving precise recognition of the binding motifs by DNA-binding proteins. While some proteins rely on short-range hydrophobic and hydrogen bonding interactions at binding sites, others employ a DNA shape readout mechanism for specific recognition. In this mechanism, variations in DNA shape at the binding motif resulted from either inherent flexibility or binding of proteins at adjacent sites are sensed and capitalized by the searching proteins to locate them specifically. Through extensive computer simulations, we investigate both scenarios to uncover the underlying mechanism and origin of specificity in the DNA shape readout mechanism. Our findings reveal that deformation in shape at the binding motif creates an entropy funnel, allowing information about altered shapes to manifest as fluctuations in minor groove widths. This signal enhances the efficiency of nonspecific search of nearby proteins by directing their movement toward the binding site, primarily driven by a gain in entropy. We propose this as a generic mechanism for DNA shape readout, where specificity arises from the alignment between the molecular frustration of the searching protein and the ruggedness of the entropic funnel governed by molecular features of the protein and arrangement of the DNA bases at the binding site, respectively.
abstract_zh: 遗传信息的准确转录至关重要，这涉及到DNA结合蛋白对结合基序的精确识别。虽然一些蛋白质依赖于结合位点处的短程疏水作用和氢键相互作用，但其他蛋白质则采用DNA形状读出机制进行特异性识别。在此机制中，结合基序处DNA形状的变化，无论是源于内在柔韧性还是邻近位点蛋白质的结合，都会被搜索中的蛋白质感知并利用，以定位它们特异性。通过广泛的计算机模拟，我们研究了这两种情况，以揭示DNA形状读出机制背后的原理及特异性起源。我们的发现表明，结合基序处的形状变形形成了一个熵漏斗，使得形状改变的信息能够表现为小沟宽度的波动。这一信号通过引导蛋白质向结合位点移动，主要依靠熵增益驱动，增强了邻近蛋白质非特异性搜索的效率。我们提出这作为DNA形状读出的一种通用机制，其中特异性源于搜索蛋白的分子挫折与熵漏斗的粗糙度之间的对齐，前者由蛋白质的分子特征决定，后者则由结合位点处DNA碱基的排列控制。
